title: Understanding Model Variance
text: Model variance refers to how much the predictions of a model will change if we use a different training dataset. High variance indicates that the model is sensitive to the specific data it was trained on.

title: Effect of Removing a Feature
text: When you remove a feature from a model, you are simplifying the model. This can lead to a decrease in model variance because the model becomes less complex and less sensitive to fluctuations in the training data.
